items.exampleEn: The princess lives in a palace.
The fairy in this story can fly.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事裡的仙女會飛。

items.exampleEn: Let's fly a kite on the beach.
My grandfather has an old CD player.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺有一台舊的 CD 播放器。

items.exampleEn: We watched a movie on DVD.
items.exampleZh: 我們看了一部 DVD 電影。

items.exampleEn: Our school has a swimming pool.

items.sentenceEn: Put the CD in the CD player.
items.sentenceZh: 把 CD 放進播放器裡。

items.audioEn: The princess and the fairy are in this DVD.
items.audioZh: 公主和仙女都在這片 DVD 裡。

items.sentenceEn: The kids fly a kite on the hill.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在山丘上放風箏。

items.sentenceEn: Let's swim in the swimming pool.

items.stemEn: The wind is strong today. Let's fly a ____.
items.stemZh: 今天風很大，我們去放風箏吧。

items.stemEn: You can watch this movie on ____.
items.stemZh: 你可以用 DVD 看這部電影。

items.passageEn: For her birthday, Nina gets a DVD about a fairy and a princess. Her brother gives her a bright yellow kite. Her grandfather gives her an old CD player and some CDs. In the afternoon, they all swim in the swimming pool. It is a wonderful birthday.
items.passageZh: Nina 生日時收到一片關於仙女和公主的 DVD。她的兄弟送她一個亮黃色的風箏，爺爺送她一台舊的 CD 播放器和幾張 CD。下午他們全都去游泳池游泳。真是個美好的生日。

items.promptZh: 這家旅館有一座很大的游泳池。
referenceEn: This hotel has a big swimming pool.
There is a big swimming pool at this hotel.
rubricZh: 「有」可用 has 或 There is…（例如 There is a big swimming pool…）
swimming pool 前面加 a（例如 a big swimming pool）

items.promptZh: 這本書是關於一位公主的故事。
referenceEn: This book is about a princess.
This story is about a princess.
rubricZh: 「關於」可寫，例如 is about 等
princess 前面加 a、the 等
